title: Cool & effective app
body: A simple to use, very clear habit apps that I can add and track action & habit that I want to develop .
author: Christy_LYS

title: I dont normally write review
body: But this app is bae! Keeping track of new habits are way better if physically recorded  than to do it mentally and this apps helps a lot in motivating me to pursue on them. It had streaks just like ur snapchat streaks tht made u obsessed to keep the streaks goin on. Also the discussion section is  fresh! Great idea and very helpful as the community can give support to people who seek motivation or help or advice from real ppl!
author: HsianalKpzm

title: Best App so far
body: I’m a clinical psychologist. I use this app for personal targets as well as with my patients. It’s user friendly, “clean” and makes monitoring “behavior” & targets so much more convenient.
author: Adddurst

title: Great App
body: If you lack discipline and need motivation this app is great !
